scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && mkdir -p backend/frontend && cp -r frontend/dist/* backend/frontend/
scripts.start: cd backend && npm install --production && node server.js
